rationale: Submitted a measurement of the client-contract consequence of the empty-command finding: the same client-probe family that showed a re-offer for a single-NOOP decision is re-run with the owner recovering its own instance so that the decided command is an empty batch, and the comparison pair asks whether the instance keeps a command and whether the pending request is re-offered.

scope.description: Owner replica 0 proposes command X with a real defs.GPropose attached (command id 91, reply writer over a local buffer) on its own instance (0,0); replica 1 holds a conflicting command so its pre-accept reply is non-equal and it fails after replying; the owner enters the Accept phase at ballot 0 towards replicas 2 and 3, of which replica 3 never pre-accepted and therefore holds no command; the owner's AcceptReplies stay in flight. The owner, alive and holding its command, then runs startRecoveryForInstance(0,0), the harness delivers the prepare replies (replica 2 carrying X at value ballot 0, replicas 3 and 4 carrying no command at the same ballot) and completes the exchange, then records the decided instance's status and command length, the pending proposals, whether the owner's propose channel received a re-offered request, and the reply writer size.
assumptions: Same construction, transport boundary and crash model as the other experiments in this harness.
The client request is supplied as the target's own defs.GPropose value and its reply writer is a harness-owned buffer.
excluded: No run() loop, no executeCommands goroutine and no client socket.

experiment.prefix: The harness drives the owner's proposal, non-equal pre-accept reply and accept phase through the target's own handlers, fails replica 1, leaves the owner's AcceptReplies undelivered, then calls the owner's startRecoveryForInstance(0,0), delivers every emitted Prepare and PrepareReply through handlePrepare/handlePrepareReply, pumps the remaining traffic and finally drains the owner's propose channel while recording its instance state.
experiment.requirement: A decision that replaces the command a live owner had pending must not silently drop the client's request: either the instance must carry that command or the pending proposal must be re-offered for a new decision, and the client must not be left without a reply and without a re-offer.
experiment.responsibility: The recovering replica's own adoption and dispatch (epaxos/epaxos.go:1239-1246, 1307-1311) together with the owner's commit handling (epaxos/epaxos.go:1082-1100); the client request was admitted through the replica's own propose path.

comparisons.description: The instance on which the owner recovered its own instance holds a command (the owner's X, length 1) after the exchange; violated when it holds an empty command list instead.

The owner's pending client request is re-offered after the decision, as it is for a single-NOOP decision; violated when nothing arrives on the owner's propose channel while the request is still marked pending.
